name: flowchart-basic-ok
source:
flowchart LR
  Q[User query] --> R{Cache hit?}
  R -- yes --> C[Return cached]
  R -- no --> M[Run model]
  M --> S[(Store result)]
  S --> C

name: flowchart-labeled-edge-ok
source:
flowchart LR
  A[Fat tree] --> B[Core]
  C[Expander] --> D[Many cuts]

name: flowchart-thick-dotted-edges-ok
source:
flowchart TD
  A[Start] ==> B[Fast path]
  A -.-> C[Fallback path]
  B --> D[Merge]
  C --> D

name: flowchart-chained-edges-fail
source:
flowchart LR
  A --> B  B --> C

name: mindmap-basic-ok
source:
mindmap
  root((Paper title))
    Contribution 1
      Detail A
      Detail B
    Contribution 2
      Detail C
    Contribution 3
      Detail D
      Detail E

source:

name: sequenceDiagram-basic-ok
source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant S as Server
  U->>S: request payload
  S-->>U: response payload
  Note over U,S: Optional annotation

name: classDiagram-basic-ok
source:
classDiagram
  class Node {
    +id: string
    +children: Node[]
    +visit() void
  }
  Node "1" --> "*" Node : children

name: stateDiagram-v2-basic-ok
source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Running : start
  Running --> Idle : stop
  Running --> [*] : crash
